---
title: "Env.GetString"
description: "Get a string value by key from the Env store."
---

Get the string value associated with `key`. Returns `""` if the key is absent or if the key holds a non-String kind.

## Signature

```enforce
static proto native string GetString(string key);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| key | `string` | The key to read. |

## Returns

The stored string. If `key` is absent or holds a non-String kind, returns `""`.

## Behavior

The result is a pointer into the pool's string storage. The engine copies it into a script-owned string at the native-call boundary, so you can read it like any other script string. After a subsequent [Env.SetString](./setstring) on the same key, or any [Env.Clear](./clear), the underlying buffer is invalidated: so do not stash a raw pointer across another write.

## Edge cases

- Missing keys return `""`.
- A `key` whose value was set by [Env.SetInt](./setint), [Env.SetBool](./setbool), or [Env.SetFloatBits](./setfloatbits) returns `""`.
- The pointer is invalidated by another `Set*` on the same key and by `Clear`.

## Example

```enforce
Env.SetString("user", "admin");
string who = Env.GetString("user"); // "admin"
```
